clues.text: Through Malachi, God told His people to bring the full amount into the storehouse and test Him.
Jesus rebuked scribes and Pharisees who paid this on mint, dill and cumin but neglected justice and mercy.
God gave these from all Israel to the Levites as their inheritance, for their work at the Tent of Meeting.
At Sinai, God said every tenth animal of the herd or flock passing under the shepherd's rod was holy to Him.
In the third year, Israelites gave this from their produce to the Levite, foreigner, fatherless and widow.
When King Hezekiah gave the order, the people of Judah brought so much of it that it lay in large heaps.
After God delivered his enemies into his hand, Abram gave Melchizedek this: a tenth of everything.
